subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Dozens and the Cosmic Dozen
description: Learn Dozens and the Cosmic Dozen in one minute.

hook.text: We buy eggs by the dozen. Twelve jurors decide trials. Twelve inches make a foot. Twelve stubbornly persists.

buildup.text: Merchants preferred twelve because it divides evenly into halves, thirds, and quarters. Practical sacred math.

discovery.text: In gematria, twelve means governmental perfection. Twelve tribes govern Israel. Twelve apostles govern the church.

twist.text: The metric system tried to standardize everything to base ten. But inches, hours, and months kept twelve alive.

climax.text: Twelve is the number that commerce, religion, and astronomy all independently chose. Practical divinity.

punchline.text: Count to twelve. The cosmos agrees.

quiz.question: Why was twelve preferred in commerce?
options: It divides evenly into halves, thirds, and quarters
